pages.title: At the door
pages.instruction: Listen for the problem, the response and the next step

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Those boxes look heavy. Do you need a hand?
lines.audioText: Those boxes look heavy. Do you need a hand?
lines.translation: Essas caixas parecem pesadas. Precisa de ajuda?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Yes, please. I can’t carry this one and open the door
lines.audioText: Yes, please. I can’t carry this one and open the door.
lines.translation: Sim, por favor. Não consigo carregar esta e abrir a porta

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: I’ll open the door. Then I’ll carry the smaller box
lines.audioText: I’ll open the door. Then I’ll carry the smaller box.
lines.translation: Vou abrir a porta. Depois carrego a caixa menor

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Thank you! I’m going to put everything in the living room
lines.audioText: Thank you! I’m going to put everything in the living room.
lines.translation: Obrigada! Vou colocar tudo na sala

questions.prompt: What does Kim offer to do first?
questions.answer: Kim offers to open the door
Ana can’t carry the box and open the door at the same time

questions.prompt: Where is Ana going to put everything?
questions.hint: She’s going to put it in …
questions.answer: Ana is going to put everything in the living room

pages.title: Making space
pages.instruction: Listen for the problem, the response and the next step

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Are you going to paint the walls today?
lines.audioText: Are you going to paint the walls today?
lines.translation: Você vai pintar as paredes hoje?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: No, that’s the plan for tomorrow. Today I just want to unpack
lines.audioText: No, that’s the plan for tomorrow. Today I just want to unpack.
lines.translation: Não, esse é o plano para amanhã. Hoje só quero desfazer as malas

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: All right. I’ll move this chair so we have more space
lines.audioText: All right. I’ll move this chair so we have more space.
lines.translation: Tudo bem. Vou mover esta cadeira para termos mais espaço

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: That would be great. We can have coffee when we finish
lines.audioText: That would be great. We can have coffee when we finish.
lines.translation: Seria ótimo. Podemos tomar café quando terminarmos

pages.title: Help with the move
pages.instruction: Offer some help and agree who will do what

pages.title: The lift isn’t working
pages.instruction: Listen for the new information and decide how to respond
pages.message: Hi, Ana! A quick update about the move: the lift isn’t working this afternoon. We have to take the stairs. The heavy box can stay downstairs for now, but I need help carrying the small bags. Could you come at three? I’m still going to paint tomorrow, so there’s no need to bring paint today. Thank you!
pages.audioText: Hi, Ana! A quick update about the move: the lift isn’t working this afternoon. We have to take the stairs. The heavy box can stay downstairs for now, but I need help carrying the small bags. Could you come at three? I’m still going to paint tomorrow, so there’s no need to bring paint today. Thank you!
pages.greeting: I have an update for you!
